source: YAML and JSON configs suit projects without Node dependencies, such as PHP, Ruby or Flutter projects. They hold the same options, except plugin objects. Presets and plugins are strings: a built-in preset name, a package name or a path.
text: YAML 與 JSON 設定檔適合沒有 Node 相依套件的專案，例如 PHP、Ruby 或 Flutter 專案。它們支援相同的選項，但外掛物件除外。預設集與外掛以字串表示：內建預設集名稱、套件名稱或路徑。
